source.text: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ףאֱֽלֹהִ֡ים בָּ֤אוּ גוֹיִ֨ם׀בְּֽנַחֲלָתֶ֗ךָ טִ֭מְּאוּ אֶת־הֵיכַ֣ל קָדְשֶׁ֑ךָ שָׂ֖מוּ אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַ֣ם לְעִיִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: A psalm of Asaph. God, nations have come into your inheritance; they have made unclean [the] temple of your holiness; they have made Jerusalem into heaps of ruins.

en.L: A psalm of Asaph. \q God, [the] nations have come into {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} inheritance; \q they have defiled {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holy temple; \q they have made Jerusalem into heaps of ruins.
en.B: A psalm of Asaph. \q God, the nations have broken into the land that is {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own; \q they have made {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holy temple unclean \q and turned Jerusalem into piles of rubble.
en.R: A song of Asaph. \q God, other nations have attacked the land that belongs to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q They have made {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holy temple unfit for worship. \q They have left Jerusalem in ruins.

fr.L: Psaume d’Asaph. \q Ô Dieu, [les] nations sont entrées dans {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} héritage ; \q elles ont souillé {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} saint temple ; \q elles ont fait de Jérusalem des monceaux de ruines.
fr.B: Psaume d’Asaph. \q Ô Dieu, les nations ont envahi le pays qui est à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; \q elles ont rendu impur {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} saint temple \q et réduit Jérusalem en tas de décombres.
fr.R: Chant d’Asaph. \q Dieu, des nations étrangères ont attaqué le pays qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appartient. \q Elles ont rendu {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} saint temple impropre au culte. \q Elles ont laissé Jérusalem en ruines.

sw.L: Zaburi ya Asafu. \q Ee Mungu, mataifa yameingia katika urithi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}; \q wamelitia unajisi hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} takatifu; \q wameifanya Yerusalemu kuwa magofu.
sw.B: Zaburi ya Asafu. \q Ee Mungu, mataifa yamevamia nchi iliyo mali {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; \q wamelinajisi hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} takatifu \q na kuigeuza Yerusalemu kuwa marundo ya kifusi.
sw.R: Wimbo wa Asafu. \q Mungu, mataifa mengine yameishambulia nchi iliyo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}. \q Wamelifanya hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} takatifu lisifae tena kwa ibada. \q Wameiacha Yerusalemu ikiwa magofu.

es.L: Salmo de Asaf. \q Oh Dios, [las] naciones han entrado en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} heredad; \q han profanado {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} santo templo; \q han convertido a Jerusalén en montones de ruinas.
es.B: Salmo de Asaf. \q Oh Dios, las naciones han invadido la tierra que es {{deity_pronoun:tuya|Tuya}}; \q han dejado impuro {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} santo templo \q y han convertido a Jerusalén en un montón de escombros.
es.R: Canto de Asaf. \q Dios, otras naciones han atacado la tierra que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} pertenece. \q Han dejado {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} santo templo sin que se pueda adorar en él. \q Han dejado a Jerusalén en ruinas.

vi.L: [Một] thi thiên của A-sáp. \q Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, các dân tộc đã xâm nhập cơ nghiệp của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q chúng đã làm ô uế đền thờ thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q chúng đã biến Giê-ru-sa-lem thành những đống đổ nát.
vi.B: Thi thiên của A-sáp. \q Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, các dân tộc đã tràn vào đất thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q chúng đã làm ô uế đền thờ thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q và biến Giê-ru-sa-lem thành những đống gạch vụn.
vi.R: Bài ca của A-sáp. \q Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, các dân tộc khác đã tấn công đất thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Chúng đã làm cho đền thờ thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không còn dùng để thờ phượng được nữa. \q Chúng đã để Giê-ru-sa-lem thành đống hoang tàn.

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: This psalm's title is short and the Hebrew counts it together with the first line as verse 1, so here the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: Asaph: a leader of the temple singers
decisions.reason: Asaph was a Levite whom David appointed to lead the singing before the ark (1 Chronicles 16:5-7); his family carried on the work. Psalms 50 and 73-83 bear his name. "Of Asaph" may mean the psalm belongs to his family's collection.

decisions.choice: the fall of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The psalm mourns a sack of Jerusalem and its temple, most likely the Babylonian conquest of 587 BC (2 Kings 25:8-10; Lamentations 1-2). Psalm 74 laments the same kind of disaster.

decisions.choice: your inheritance: what belongs to God as his own
decisions.reason: The word (nachalah) is a family's inherited land. Israel and its land are called God's own inheritance (Deuteronomy 32:9; Exodus 15:17).

decisions.choice: defiled: made ritually unclean
decisions.reason: The verb (tame') means to make unclean, unfit for the worship of God. Foreigners entering the holy place and the dead lying there defile it (Ezekiel 9:7).

decisions.choice: the land that is your own (B); the land that belongs to you (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say plainly what "inheritance" means here (m4).

decisions.choice: unfit for worship
decisions.reason: Readable explains what being made unclean means for a temple (m5).

source.text: נָֽתְנ֡וּ אֶת־נִבְלַ֬ת עֲבָדֶ֗יךָ מַ֭אֲכָל לְע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם בְּשַׂ֥ר חֲ֝סִידֶ֗יךָ לְחַיְתוֹ־אָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: They have given [the] corpse[s] of your servants [as] food to [the] birds of the heavens, [the] flesh of your faithful [ones] to [the] animals of [the] earth.

en.L: They have given the corpses of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servants [as] food to the birds of the heavens, \q the flesh of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful ones to the beasts of [the] earth.
en.B: They have thrown out the bodies of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servants for the birds of the air to eat, \q and the flesh of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful people for the wild animals.
en.R: The bodies of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servants lie out in the open, and birds eat them. \q Wild animals feed on the bodies of the people who are loyal to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Ils ont donné les cadavres de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} esclaves [en] nourriture aux oiseaux des cieux, \q la chair de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} fidèles aux bêtes de [la] terre.
fr.B: Ils ont jeté les corps de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} serviteurs en pâture aux oiseaux du ciel, \q et la chair de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} fidèles aux bêtes sauvages.
fr.R: Les corps de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} serviteurs restent en plein air, et les oiseaux les mangent. \q Les bêtes sauvages dévorent les corps de ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} sont fidèles.

sw.L: Wameitoa mizoga ya watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} [kuwa] chakula cha ndege wa angani, \q nyama ya waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kwa wanyama wa nchi.
sw.B: Wameitupa miili ya watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} ili ndege wa angani waile, \q na nyama ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} waaminifu kwa wanyama wa porini.
sw.R: Miili ya watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} imelala nje wazi, na ndege wanaila. \q Wanyama wa porini wanakula miili ya watu walio waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}.

es.L: Han dado los cadáveres de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} siervos [como] comida a las aves de los cielos, \q la carne de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} fieles a las bestias de [la] tierra.
es.B: Han tirado los cuerpos de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} siervos para que se los coman las aves del cielo, \q y la carne de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} fieles para las fieras.
es.R: Los cuerpos de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} siervos quedaron tirados al aire libre, y las aves se los comen. \q Los animales salvajes se alimentan de los cuerpos de la gente que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} es leal.

vi.L: Chúng đã bỏ xác các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [làm] thức ăn cho chim trời, \q và thịt những người trung tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho thú vật trên đất.
vi.B: Chúng ném xác các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho chim trời ăn, \q và thịt những người trung tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho thú rừng.
vi.R: Xác các đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nằm phơi ngoài trời, và chim chóc ăn xác họ. \q Thú rừng ăn xác những người trung thành với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: food for birds and beasts: left unburied
decisions.reason: To be left unburied and eaten by birds and animals was the worst disgrace, one of the curses of the covenant (Deuteronomy 28:26; Jeremiah 7:33).

decisions.choice: your faithful ones: people loyal to God
decisions.reason: The word (chasid) comes from chesed, loyal love: people who keep faith with God (4:4; 50:5).

decisions.choice: animals of the earth: an old form of the word
decisions.reason: The word for "animals" has an old poetic ending here, as in Genesis 1:24. The meaning is the ordinary one: wild animals.

decisions.choice: lie out in the open
decisions.reason: Readable says what giving the bodies to birds and beasts means: no one buried them (verse 3).

source.text: שָׁפְכ֬וּ דָמָ֨ם׀כַּמַּ֗יִם סְֽבִ֘יב֤וֹת יְֽרוּשָׁלִָ֗ם וְאֵ֣ין קוֹבֵֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: They have poured out their blood like water around Jerusalem, and there [was] none burying.

en.L: They have poured out their blood like water all around Jerusalem, \q and there [was] no one burying.
en.B: They have spilled their blood like water on every side of Jerusalem, \q and no one was left to bury them.
en.R: Their blood has flowed like water all around Jerusalem, \q and nobody is left to bury the bodies.

fr.L: Ils ont versé leur sang comme de l’eau tout autour de Jérusalem, \q et il n’y [avait] personne pour enterrer.
fr.B: Ils ont répandu leur sang comme de l’eau de tous côtés autour de Jérusalem, \q et il ne restait personne pour les ensevelir.
fr.R: Leur sang a coulé comme de l’eau tout autour de Jérusalem, \q et il ne reste personne pour enterrer les morts.

sw.L: Wamemwaga damu yao kama maji pande zote za Yerusalemu, \q wala hapakuwa na mtu wa kuzika.
sw.B: Wameimwaga damu yao kama maji kila upande wa Yerusalemu, \q wala hakubaki mtu wa kuwazika.
sw.R: Damu yao imetiririka kama maji kuizunguka Yerusalemu, \q wala hakuna aliyebaki kuzika maiti.

es.L: Han derramado su sangre como agua alrededor de Jerusalén, \q y no [hubo] quien [los] enterrara.
es.B: Han derramado su sangre como agua por todos los lados de Jerusalén, \q y no quedó nadie que los enterrara.
es.R: Su sangre ha corrido como agua alrededor de Jerusalén, \q y no queda nadie que entierre los cuerpos.

vi.L: Chúng đã đổ máu họ ra như nước khắp chung quanh Giê-ru-sa-lem, \q và không có ai chôn cất.
vi.B: Chúng làm đổ máu họ như nước khắp bốn phía Giê-ru-sa-lem, \q và không còn ai để chôn cất họ.
vi.R: Máu họ chảy như nước khắp chung quanh Giê-ru-sa-lem, \q và không còn ai chôn cất các xác chết.

decisions.choice: poured out their blood like water: killed many without restraint
decisions.reason: Water is poured out freely and without thought. The picture is of killing on a huge scale, blood treated as if it were worth nothing.

decisions.choice: none burying: no one was left to do it
decisions.reason: The participle (qover) means "one who buries". So many were killed, or the survivors were so scattered, that no one buried the dead (Jeremiah 14:16).

source.text: הָיִ֣ינוּ חֶ֭רְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵ֑ינוּ לַ֥עַג וָ֝קֶ֗לֶס לִסְבִיבוֹתֵֽינוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a mockery and derision to [those] around us.

en.L: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, \q a mockery and a derision to those around us.
en.B: We have become a disgrace in our neighbors' eyes, \q laughed at and scorned by everyone near us.
en.R: The nations next to us insult us. \q The people around us laugh at us and make fun of us.

fr.L: Nous sommes devenus une insulte pour nos voisins, \q une moquerie et une risée pour ceux qui nous entourent.
fr.B: Nous sommes devenus une honte aux yeux de nos voisins, \q un objet de moquerie et de mépris pour tous ceux qui nous entourent.
fr.R: Les nations voisines nous insultent. \q Les gens autour de nous rient de nous et se moquent de nous.

sw.L: Tumekuwa aibu kwa jirani zetu, \q dhihaka na mzaha kwa wale wanaotuzunguka.
sw.B: Tumekuwa fedheha machoni pa jirani zetu, \q tukichekwa na kudharauliwa na wote walio karibu nasi.
sw.R: Mataifa jirani wanatutukana. \q Watu wanaotuzunguka wanatucheka na kutudhihaki.

es.L: Hemos llegado a ser afrenta para nuestros vecinos, \q burla y escarnio para los que nos rodean.
es.B: Nos hemos convertido en una vergüenza a los ojos de nuestros vecinos; \q todos los que están cerca se ríen de nosotros y nos desprecian.
es.R: Las naciones vecinas nos insultan. \q La gente que nos rodea se ríe de nosotros y se burla.

vi.L: Chúng tôi đã trở thành sự sỉ nhục cho những người láng giềng, \q một trò cười và sự chế giễu cho những kẻ chung quanh chúng tôi.
vi.B: Chúng tôi đã trở nên điều ô nhục trước mắt các dân láng giềng, \q bị mọi người chung quanh cười chê và khinh bỉ.
vi.R: Các dân tộc láng giềng sỉ nhục chúng tôi. \q Những người chung quanh cười nhạo và chế giễu chúng tôi.

decisions.choice: the words of 44:14
decisions.reason: The line is almost the same as 44:14. Israel's disgrace among the nations is also a slur on its God (verses 10 and 12).

decisions.choice: a reproach: an object of insult
decisions.reason: The word (cherpah) is scorn and the shame it brings. It returns in verse 12, where the neighbors' insults are said to be aimed at God himself.

source.text: עַד־מָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תֶּאֱנַ֣ף לָנֶ֑צַח תִּבְעַ֥ר כְּמוֹ־אֵ֝֗שׁ קִנְאָתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Until when, YHWH? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?

en.L: Until when, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}? Will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} be angry forever? \q Will {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} jealousy burn like fire?
en.B: How long, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}? Will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} be angry without end? \q Must {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} jealousy keep burning like fire?
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, how long will this go on? Will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} stay angry forever? \q Will {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} jealous anger keep burning like a fire?

fr.L: Jusqu’à quand, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ? Seras-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} irrité pour toujours ? \q Ta jalousie brûlera-t-elle comme un feu ?
fr.B: Jusqu’à quand, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ? Seras-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} en colère sans fin ? \q Ta jalousie doit-elle brûler encore comme un feu ?
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, combien de temps cela va-t-il durer ? Resteras-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} en colère pour toujours ? \q Ta colère jalouse va-t-elle brûler encore comme un feu ?

sw.L: Mpaka lini, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}? Je, utakasirika milele? \q Je, wivu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} utawaka kama moto?
sw.B: Mpaka lini, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}? Je, utakasirika bila mwisho? \q Je, wivu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} utaendelea kuwaka kama moto?
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hali hii itaendelea mpaka lini? Je, utakaa ukiwa na hasira milele? \q Je, hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ya wivu itaendelea kuwaka kama moto?

es.L: ¿Hasta cuándo, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}? ¿Estarás enojado para siempre? \q ¿Arderán {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} celos como fuego?
es.B: ¿Hasta cuándo, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}? ¿Estarás enojado sin fin? \q ¿Han de seguir ardiendo {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} celos como fuego?
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¿hasta cuándo va a seguir esto? ¿Vas a estar enojado para siempre? \q ¿Seguirá ardiendo {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ira celosa como un fuego?

vi.L: Cho đến bao giờ, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}? Ngài sẽ giận mãi mãi sao? \q Lòng ghen của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ cháy như lửa sao?
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, cho đến bao giờ? Ngài sẽ giận mãi không thôi sao? \q Lòng ghen của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cứ cháy như lửa mãi sao?
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, việc này sẽ còn kéo dài đến bao giờ? Ngài sẽ giận mãi mãi sao? \q Cơn giận ghen tuông của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cứ cháy như lửa mãi sao?

decisions.choice: until when: how long
decisions.reason: The question ("until what?") is the cry of lament heard in 13:2 and 74:10: how long must this last?

decisions.choice: your jealousy: God's burning zeal for what is his
decisions.reason: The word (qin'ah) is the passion of one who will not share what is rightly his. God is "jealous" for his covenant with his people (Exodus 20:5; 34:14); here his anger at their unfaithfulness has burned against them.

decisions.choice: jealous anger
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that this jealousy is God's anger (m2).

source.text: שְׁפֹ֤ךְ חֲמָתְךָ֨ אֶֽל־הַגּוֹיִם֮ אֲשֶׁ֪ר לֹא־יְדָ֫ע֥וּךָ וְעַ֥ל מַמְלָכ֑וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ֝שִׁמְךָ֗ לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Pour out your wrath on the nations that not know you, and on kingdoms that on your name not call,

en.L: Pour out {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wrath on the nations that do not know {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, \q and on [the] kingdoms \q that do not call on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name,
en.B: Pour out {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} fury on the nations that have not known {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, \q on the kingdoms \q that never call on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name,
en.R: Pour out {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anger on the nations that do not know {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q Pour it out on the kingdoms that do not worship {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Déverse {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fureur sur les nations qui ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} connaissent pas, \q et sur [les] royaumes \q qui n’invoquent pas {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom,
fr.B: Répands {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fureur sur les nations qui ne {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}ont pas connu, \q sur les royaumes \q qui n’invoquent jamais {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom,
fr.R: Déverse {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère sur les nations qui ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} connaissent pas. \q Déverse-la sur les royaumes qui ne {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}adorent pas.

sw.L: Imwage ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} juu ya mataifa yasiyokujua {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, \q na juu ya falme \q zisizoliitia jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}},
sw.B: Imwage hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kali juu ya mataifa ambayo hayajakujua {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, \q juu ya falme \q zisizoliitia jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} kamwe,
sw.R: Imwage hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} juu ya mataifa yasiyokujua {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}. \q Imwage juu ya falme zisizokuabudu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}.

es.L: Derrama {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ira sobre las naciones que no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} conocen, \q y sobre [los] reinos \q que no invocan {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre,
es.B: Derrama {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} furor sobre las naciones que no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} han conocido, \q sobre los reinos \q que nunca invocan {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre,
es.R: Derrama {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} enojo sobre las naciones que no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} conocen. \q Derrámalo sobre los reinos que no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} adoran.

vi.L: Xin đổ cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên các dân tộc không biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và trên [các] vương quốc \q không kêu cầu danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.B: Xin trút cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên các dân tộc không biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q trên các vương quốc \q không hề kêu cầu danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.R: Xin đổ cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên các dân tộc không biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Xin đổ nó trên các vương quốc không thờ phượng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: the words of Jeremiah 10:25
decisions.reason: Verses 6-7 are almost the same as Jeremiah 10:25. The prayer asks that the anger now falling on Israel fall instead on the nations that destroyed it.

decisions.choice: know you: acknowledge God and belong to him
decisions.reason: To "know" God is to acknowledge him and live in relationship with him (36:11), not simply to know about him.

decisions.choice: call on your name: pray to and worship God
decisions.reason: To call on someone's name is to pray to him and worship him (Genesis 12:8; 80:19).

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: The reason ("for ...") follows in verse 7, so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: do not worship you
alternatives: do not call on your name
decisions.reason: Readable says what calling on God's name means (m3).

records.literal_gloss: for he has devoured Jacob, and his dwelling they have laid waste.

en.L: for he has devoured Jacob, \q and his pasture they have laid waste.
en.B: for they have swallowed up Jacob \q and left his homeland desolate.
en.R: They have destroyed Jacob's people \q and ruined the land where they lived.

fr.L: car il a dévoré Jacob, \q et ils ont dévasté son pâturage.
fr.B: car ils ont englouti Jacob \q et dévasté sa patrie.
fr.R: Ils ont détruit le peuple de Jacob \q et ravagé le pays où il vivait.

sw.L: kwa maana amemla Yakobo, \q na malisho yake wameyafanya ukiwa.
sw.B: kwa maana wamemmeza Yakobo \q na kuiacha nchi yake ikiwa ukiwa.
sw.R: Wamewaangamiza watu wa Yakobo \q na kuiharibu nchi waliyoishi.

es.L: porque él ha devorado a Jacob, \q y su pastizal han asolado.
es.B: porque se han tragado a Jacob \q y han dejado desolada su tierra.
es.R: Han destruido al pueblo de Jacob \q y han arruinado la tierra donde vivían.

vi.L: vì nó đã nuốt Gia-cốp, \q và đồng cỏ của người, chúng đã tàn phá.
vi.B: vì chúng đã nuốt chửng Gia-cốp \q và làm cho quê hương người trở nên hoang vắng.
vi.R: Chúng đã tiêu diệt dân của Gia-cốp \q và tàn phá đất họ sinh sống.

decisions.choice: he has devoured ... they have laid waste
decisions.reason: The first verb is singular, treating the enemy as one; the second is plural. Jeremiah 10:25 has the plural in both places. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: Jacob: the people of Israel
decisions.reason: Jacob, renamed Israel (Genesis 32), stands for the nation descended from him.

decisions.choice: his pasture: the land where Jacob lives
decisions.reason: The word (naveh) is a pasture or the place where shepherds and flocks settle, and so a home. The picture fits verse 13, where the people are God's flock.

decisions.choice: they
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the plural for the enemy throughout the verse (m1).

decisions.choice: Jacob's people; the land where they lived
decisions.reason: Readable says who Jacob stands for (m2).

source.text: אַֽל־תִּזְכָּר־לָנוּ֮ עֲוֺנֹ֪ת רִאשֹׁ֫נִ֥ים מַ֭הֵר יְקַדְּמ֣וּנוּ רַחֲמֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י דַלּ֣וֹנוּ מְאֹֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: Do not remember against us iniquities of former [ones]; quickly let your compassions come to meet us, for we have become very low.

en.L: Do not remember against us [the] iniquities of [the] former ones; \q quickly let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} compassion come to meet us, \q for we have been brought very low.
en.B: Do not count against us the wrongs of those who came before us; \q let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} compassion hurry to meet us, \q for we are at the end of our strength.
en.R: Do not punish us for the sins of the people who lived before us. \q Hurry to show us {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loving care, \q because we are completely helpless.

fr.L: Ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} souviens pas contre nous des fautes des anciens ; \q que vite {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} compassion vienne à notre rencontre, \q car nous avons été réduits à rien.
fr.B: Ne retiens pas contre nous les fautes de ceux qui nous ont précédés ; \q que {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} tendresse se hâte à notre rencontre, \q car nous sommes au bout de nos forces.
fr.R: Ne nous punis pas pour les péchés des gens qui ont vécu avant nous. \q Viens vite nous montrer {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour plein de tendresse, \q car nous sommes sans aucune force.

sw.L: Usikumbuke juu yetu maovu ya [watu wa] kwanza; \q huruma {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} zije upesi kutulaki, \q kwa maana tumeshushwa chini sana.
sw.B: Usituhesabie makosa ya wale waliotutangulia; \q huruma {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} na ziharakishe kutulaki, \q kwa maana nguvu zetu zimekwisha kabisa.
sw.R: Usituadhibu kwa dhambi za watu walioishi kabla yetu. \q Uharakishe kutuonyesha upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa huruma, \q kwa sababu hatuna msaada wowote.

es.L: No recuerdes contra nosotros [las] iniquidades de [los] antepasados; \q que pronto {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} compasión salga a nuestro encuentro, \q porque hemos sido muy abatidos.
es.B: No nos tomes en cuenta las faltas de los que vinieron antes de nosotros; \q que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} compasión se apresure a salirnos al encuentro, \q porque ya no nos quedan fuerzas.
es.R: No nos castigues por los pecados de los que vivieron antes que nosotros. \q Date prisa en mostrarnos {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} tierno cuidado, \q porque no podemos hacer nada para ayudarnos.

vi.L: Xin đừng nhớ đến những tội ác của [những người] trước kia mà nghịch cùng chúng tôi; \q xin cho lòng thương xót của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mau đến đón chúng tôi, \q vì chúng tôi đã bị hạ xuống rất thấp.
vi.B: Xin đừng kể những tội lỗi của những người đi trước mà buộc tội chúng tôi; \q xin cho lòng thương xót của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mau đến gặp chúng tôi, \q vì chúng tôi đã kiệt sức rồi.
vi.R: Xin đừng phạt chúng tôi vì tội lỗi của những người sống trước chúng tôi. \q Xin mau tỏ tình thương chăm sóc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho chúng tôi, \q vì chúng tôi hoàn toàn bất lực.

decisions.choice: iniquities of the former ones: the sins of earlier generations
decisions.reason: The word ri'shonim can mean "people of former times" (the ancestors, as in Leviticus 26:45) or describe the sins as "former" ones. The people confess that the disaster came because of long unfaithfulness (Lamentations 5:7).

decisions.choice: remember against us: hold it against us
decisions.reason: To "remember" a sin against someone is to act on it and punish it (25:7).

decisions.choice: your compassion: the tender love of God
decisions.reason: The word (rachamim) is related to the word for the womb: the love of a mother for her child (51:3).

decisions.choice: brought very low: weak and helpless
decisions.reason: The verb (dalal) means to become thin, weak, or poor (116:6).

source.text: עָזְרֵ֤נוּ׀אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י יִשְׁעֵ֗נוּ עַל־דְּבַ֥ר כְּבֽוֹד־שְׁמֶ֑ךָ וְהַצִּילֵ֥נוּ וְכַפֵּ֥ר עַל־חַ֝טֹּאתֵ֗ינוּ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Help us, God of our salvation, on account of [the] glory of your name; and deliver us and atone for our sins for the sake of your name.

en.L: Help us, God of our salvation, \q for the sake of the glory of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name; \q and deliver us and atone for our sins for the sake of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name.
en.B: God who saves us, come to our help for the glory of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name. \q Rescue us and cover our sins, to honor {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name.
en.R: God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are the one who saves us. \q Help us, so that people will see how great {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are. \q Save us and forgive our sins, so that {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name will be honored.

fr.L: Aide-nous, Dieu de notre salut, \q pour la gloire de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom ; \q et délivre-nous et fais l’expiation pour nos péchés à cause de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom.
fr.B: Dieu qui nous sauves, viens à notre aide pour la gloire de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom. \q Délivre-nous et couvre nos péchés, pour l’honneur de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom.
fr.R: Dieu, c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui nous sauves. \q Aide-nous, pour que les gens voient combien {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es grand. \q Sauve-nous et pardonne nos péchés, pour que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom soit honoré.

sw.L: Utusaidie, Ee Mungu wa wokovu wetu, \q kwa ajili ya utukufu wa jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}; \q utuokoe na kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.
sw.B: Ee Mungu unayetuokoa, uje utusaidie kwa ajili ya utukufu wa jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}. \q Utuokoe na kuzifunika dhambi zetu, kwa heshima ya jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.
sw.R: Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiwe unayetuokoa. \q Utusaidie, ili watu waone jinsi {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulivyo mkuu. \q Utuokoe na kutusamehe dhambi zetu, ili jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} liheshimiwe.

es.L: Ayúdanos, oh Dios de nuestra salvación, \q por la gloria de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre; \q y líbranos y perdona nuestros pecados por amor de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre.
es.B: Dios que nos salvas, ven a ayudarnos por la gloria de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre. \q Rescátanos y cubre nuestros pecados, para honrar {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre.
es.R: Dios, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres el que nos salva. \q Ayúdanos, para que la gente vea lo grande que eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}. \q Sálvanos y perdona nuestros pecados, para que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre sea honrado.

vi.L: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời của sự cứu rỗi chúng tôi, xin giúp đỡ chúng tôi, \q vì vinh quang của danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q và xin giải cứu chúng tôi và chuộc tội chúng tôi vì danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng cứu rỗi chúng tôi, xin đến giúp chúng tôi vì vinh quang của danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Xin giải cứu chúng tôi và tha thứ tội lỗi chúng tôi để tôn vinh danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng cứu chúng tôi. \q Xin giúp chúng tôi, để người ta thấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vĩ đại dường nào. \q Xin cứu chúng tôi và tha tội cho chúng tôi, để danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được tôn kính.

decisions.choice: for the sake of your name: for God's own honor
decisions.reason: God's "name" is his reputation among the nations. If his people stay ruined, the nations will think he is powerless (verse 10). The prayer appeals to his honor, not to the people's merit (23:3; Ezekiel 36:22).

decisions.choice: atone for: cover and wipe away
decisions.reason: The verb (kipper) is the word used for atonement by sacrifice. With God as subject it means that he himself removes the guilt (65:4; 78:38).

decisions.choice: God who saves us (B); the one who saves us (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn "God of our salvation" into a clause.

decisions.choice: so that people will see how great you are
alternatives: for the glory of your name
decisions.reason: Readable explains the glory of God's name as what others see of him (m1).

source.text: לָ֤מָּה׀יֹאמְר֣וּ הַגּוֹיִם֮ אַיֵּ֪ה אֱֽלֹהֵ֫יהֶ֥ם יִוָּדַ֣ע בַּגּוֹיִ֣ם לְעֵינֵ֑ינוּ נִ֝קְמַ֗ת דַּֽם־עֲבָדֶ֥יךָ הַשָּׁפֽוּךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Why should say the nations, Where [is] their God? Let be known among the nations before our eyes [the] vengeance of [the] blood of your servants that is poured out.

en.L: Why should the nations say, "Where [is] their God?" \q Let there be known among the nations before our eyes \q the avenging of the blood of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servants that was poured out.
en.B: Why should the nations get to say, "Where is their God?" \q Let the nations see {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} pay back the blood of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servants that was shed, \q and let us see it with our own eyes.
en.R: Do not let the nations ask, "Where is their God?" \q Your servants' blood has been spilled. \q Let the nations see {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} punish those who did it, and let us see it too.

fr.L: Pourquoi les nations diraient-elles : « Où [est] leur Dieu ? » \q Que soit connue parmi les nations, sous nos yeux, \q la vengeance du sang de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} esclaves qui a été versé.
fr.B: Pourquoi les nations pourraient-elles dire : « Où est leur Dieu ? » \q Que les nations {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} voient faire justice pour le sang versé de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} serviteurs, \q et que nous le voyions de nos propres yeux.
fr.R: Ne laisse pas les nations demander : « Où est leur Dieu ? » \q Le sang de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} serviteurs a été versé. \q Que les nations {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} voient punir ceux qui ont fait cela, et que nous le voyions aussi.

sw.L: Kwa nini mataifa waseme, "Yuko wapi Mungu wao?" \q Na ijulikane kati ya mataifa mbele ya macho yetu \q kisasi cha damu ya watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} iliyomwagwa.
sw.B: Kwa nini mataifa wapate kusema, "Yuko wapi Mungu wao?" \q Mataifa na wakuone {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ukilipiza damu ya watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} iliyomwagwa, \q nasi tuone kwa macho yetu wenyewe.
sw.R: Usiyaache mataifa yaulize, "Yuko wapi Mungu wao?" \q Damu ya watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} imemwagwa. \q Mataifa na yakuone {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ukiwaadhibu wale waliofanya hivyo, nasi tuone pia.

es.L: ¿Por qué han de decir las naciones: «¿Dónde [está] su Dios?»? \q Que sea conocida entre las naciones, ante nuestros ojos, \q la venganza de la sangre derramada de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} siervos.
es.B: ¿Por qué han de poder decir las naciones: «¿Dónde está su Dios?»? \q Que las naciones {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} vean cobrar la sangre derramada de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} siervos, \q y que nosotros lo veamos con nuestros propios ojos.
es.R: No dejes que las naciones pregunten: «¿Dónde está su Dios?». \q La sangre de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} siervos ha sido derramada. \q Que las naciones {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} vean castigar a los que lo hicieron, y que nosotros también lo veamos.

vi.L: Sao các dân tộc lại nói: "Đức Chúa Trời của chúng nó [ở] đâu?" \q Nguyện giữa các dân tộc, trước mắt chúng tôi, người ta biết đến \q sự báo thù cho máu các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã bị đổ ra.
vi.B: Sao các dân tộc lại được nói: "Đức Chúa Trời của chúng nó ở đâu?" \q Xin cho các dân tộc thấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} báo trả máu các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đổ ra, \q và cho chúng tôi được tận mắt nhìn thấy.
vi.R: Xin đừng để các dân tộc hỏi: "Đức Chúa Trời của chúng nó đâu?" \q Máu các đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đổ ra. \q Xin cho các dân tộc thấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trừng phạt những kẻ đã làm điều đó, và cho chúng tôi cũng được thấy.

decisions.choice: among the nations: the form as read
decisions.reason: The words follow the form the Hebrew text's notes say to read; the written form is spelled slightly differently. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: Where is their God?: a taunt
decisions.reason: The taunt says that Israel's God has failed them or does not exist (42:4; 115:2). The prayer asks God to answer it by acting.

decisions.choice: vengeance: the judge's just redress
decisions.reason: The word (neqamah) is the repayment a just judge or a family's protector brings for blood shed wrongly. It is left to God, not taken by the people (Deuteronomy 32:43).

decisions.choice: pay back (B); punish those who did it (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the noun a verb with God as the one who acts (m3).

source.text: תָּ֤ב֣וֹא לְפָנֶיךָ֮ אֶנְקַ֪ת אָ֫סִ֥יר כְּגֹ֥דֶל זְרוֹעֲךָ֑ ה֝וֹתֵ֗ר בְּנֵ֣י תְמוּתָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Let come before you [the] groaning of [the] prisoner; according to [the] greatness of your arm, leave over [the] sons of death.

en.L: Let the groaning of the prisoner come before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; \q according to the greatness of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} arm, \q preserve the sons of death.
en.B: May the groaning of the captives reach {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; \q with the might of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} arm, \q spare those who are marked for death.
en.R: Listen to the prisoners as they groan. \q Your power is great. \q Save the people who are going to be killed.

fr.L: Que le gémissement du prisonnier vienne devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; \q selon la grandeur de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} bras, \q préserve les fils de la mort.
fr.B: Que la plainte des captifs parvienne jusqu’à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; \q par la force de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} bras, \q épargne ceux qui sont promis à la mort.
fr.R: Écoute les prisonniers qui gémissent. \q Ta puissance est grande. \q Sauve ceux qu’on va faire mourir.

sw.L: Kuugua kwa mfungwa na kufike mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; \q kwa ukuu wa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, \q uwahifadhi wana wa mauti.
sw.B: Kuugua kwa mateka na kukufikie {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}; \q kwa uweza wa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, \q uwaepushe wale waliohukumiwa kufa.
sw.R: Wasikilize wafungwa wanapougua. \q Uweza {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} ni mkuu. \q Uwaokoe watu wanaokaribia kuuawa.

es.L: Que llegue delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} el gemido del preso; \q conforme a la grandeza de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} brazo, \q preserva a los hijos de la muerte.
es.B: Que el gemido de los cautivos llegue hasta {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; \q con la fuerza de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} brazo, \q salva a los que están condenados a muerte.
es.R: Escucha a los presos cuando gimen. \q Tu poder es grande. \q Salva a la gente que van a matar.

vi.L: Nguyện tiếng rên rỉ của người tù thấu đến trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q theo sự vĩ đại của cánh tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q xin giữ lại những con cái của sự chết.
vi.B: Nguyện tiếng than thở của những người bị giam cầm thấu đến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q bằng sức mạnh cánh tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q xin cứu những người đã bị định phải chết.
vi.R: Xin lắng nghe những người tù đang rên rỉ. \q Quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật lớn lao. \q Xin cứu những người sắp bị giết.

decisions.choice: sons of death: people condemned to die
decisions.reason: "Sons of" marks people who belong to something; here, those already doomed to death (102:21; 1 Samuel 26:16).

decisions.choice: leave over: keep alive, let survive
decisions.reason: The verb (yatar, causative) means to leave a remnant, to let some survive. The ancient Greek translation took it as "set free" from a similar-looking word.

decisions.choice: your arm: your power
decisions.reason: The arm stands for strength in action, as in the rescue from Egypt (Exodus 6:6).

decisions.choice: Listen to the prisoners
alternatives: let the groaning come before you
decisions.reason: Readable turns the wish into a direct request.

source.text: וְהָ֘שֵׁ֤ב לִשְׁכֵנֵ֣ינוּ שִׁ֭בְעָתַיִם אֶל־חֵיקָ֑ם חֶרְפָּ֘תָ֤ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר חֵרְפ֣וּךָ אֲדֹנָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And return to our neighbors sevenfold into their bosom their reproach [with] which they reproached you, my Lord.

en.L: And return to our neighbors sevenfold into their lap \q their taunting with which they have taunted {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, my Lord.
en.B: Pay back our neighbors seven times over, right into their laps, \q for the scorn they have heaped on {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, Lord.
en.R: Lord, our neighbors have insulted {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q Pay them back in full, seven times over.

fr.L: Et rends à nos voisins sept fois dans leur sein \q l’insulte dont ils {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}ont insulté, mon Seigneur.
fr.B: Rends à nos voisins sept fois plus, en plein dans leurs bras, \q pour le mépris qu’ils ont jeté sur {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, Seigneur.
fr.R: Seigneur, nos voisins {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}ont insulté. \q Rends-leur tout, sept fois plus.

sw.L: Uwarudishie jirani zetu mara saba vifuani mwao \q matukano yao ambayo kwayo wamekutukana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee Bwana wangu.
sw.B: Uwalipe jirani zetu mara saba, moja kwa moja vifuani mwao, \q kwa dharau waliyokurundikia {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee Bwana.
sw.R: Bwana, jirani zetu wamekutukana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}. \q Uwalipe kikamilifu, mara saba.

es.L: Y devuelve a nuestros vecinos siete veces en su regazo \q la afrenta con que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} han afrentado, Señor mío.
es.B: Paga a nuestros vecinos siete veces más, directamente en su regazo, \q por el desprecio que han echado sobre {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, Señor.
es.R: Señor, nuestros vecinos {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} han insultado. \q Págales por completo, siete veces más.

vi.L: Và xin báo trả gấp bảy lần vào lòng những kẻ láng giềng của chúng tôi \q sự sỉ nhục mà chúng đã sỉ nhục {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy Chúa.
vi.B: Xin báo trả các dân láng giềng gấp bảy lần, đổ ngay vào lòng chúng, \q vì những lời khinh miệt chúng đã đổ trên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy Chúa.
vi.R: Lạy Chúa, các dân láng giềng đã sỉ nhục {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Xin báo trả chúng cho đủ, gấp bảy lần.

decisions.choice: into their bosom: right into their lap
decisions.reason: The fold of a robe at the chest served as a pocket. To pay something into it is to give it in full, directly to the person (Isaiah 65:6; Luke 6:38).

decisions.choice: sevenfold: in full measure
decisions.reason: Seven is the number of completeness (Genesis 4:15; Proverbs 6:31).

decisions.choice: they reproached you: the insult is against God
decisions.reason: The neighbors mocked Israel (verse 4), but in mocking God's people they insulted God. The psalmist asks God to answer the insult rather than taking revenge.

decisions.choice: my Lord (L); Lord (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, 'Adonai in address is "my Lord" at Literal and "Lord" at Balanced and Readable.

source.text: וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ עַמְּךָ֨׀וְצֹ֥אן מַרְעִיתֶךָ֮ נ֤וֹדֶ֥ה לְּךָ֗ לְע֫וֹלָ֥ם לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֑ר נְ֝סַפֵּ֗ר תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And we, your people and [the] sheep of your pasture, will give thanks to you forever; to generation and generation we will recount your praise.

en.L: And we, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people and the sheep of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} pasture, will give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} forever; \q to generation and generation \q we will recount {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} praise.
en.B: Then we, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people, the flock {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} tend, will thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for all time; \q to every generation \q we will tell of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} praise.
en.R: We are {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people, the sheep {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} take care of. \q We will thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} forever. \q We will tell our children and their children how great {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are.

fr.L: Et nous, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple et les brebis de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} pâturage, nous {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendrons grâce pour toujours ; \q de génération en génération \q nous raconterons {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} louange.
fr.B: Alors nous, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple, le troupeau dont {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} prends soin, nous {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendrons grâce à jamais ; \q à chaque génération \q nous dirons {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} louange.
fr.R: Nous sommes {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple, les brebis dont {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} prends soin. \q Nous {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercierons pour toujours. \q Nous dirons à nos enfants et à leurs enfants combien {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es grand.

sw.L: Nasi, watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} na kondoo wa malisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, tutakushukuru {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} milele; \q kwa kizazi na kizazi \q tutasimulia sifa {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Ndipo sisi, watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, kundi unalolichunga {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, tutakushukuru siku zote; \q kwa kila kizazi \q tutasimulia sifa {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.R: Sisi ni watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, kondoo unaowatunza {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}. \q Tutakushukuru milele. \q Tutawaambia watoto wetu na watoto wao jinsi {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulivyo mkuu.

es.L: Y nosotros, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo y ovejas de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} prado, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} daremos gracias para siempre; \q de generación en generación \q contaremos {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} alabanza.
es.B: Entonces nosotros, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo, el rebaño que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} cuidas, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} daremos gracias por siempre; \q a cada generación \q contaremos {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} alabanza.
es.R: Somos {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo, las ovejas que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} cuidas. \q Te daremos gracias para siempre. \q Contaremos a nuestros hijos y a sus hijos lo grande que eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}.

vi.L: Còn chúng tôi, là dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và chiên của đồng cỏ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời; \q từ đời này sang đời kia \q chúng tôi sẽ thuật lại sự ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Bấy giờ chúng tôi, là dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là đàn chiên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chăn giữ, sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mãi mãi; \q cho mọi thế hệ \q chúng tôi sẽ kể lại lời ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Chúng tôi là dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là đàn chiên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chăm sóc. \q Chúng tôi sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời. \q Chúng tôi sẽ kể cho con cháu mình biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vĩ đại dường nào.

decisions.choice: the sheep of your pasture: God as shepherd
decisions.reason: Israel is God's flock and he is their shepherd (74:1; 95:7; 100:3). Psalm 80 opens with the same picture.

decisions.choice: to generation and generation: to every generation to come
decisions.reason: The praise will be passed down from parents to children for all time (78:4).

decisions.choice: our children and their children
decisions.reason: Readable gives a concrete picture of the generations to come (m2).
